data.title: 丰川祥子 · 打工更衣室白衬衫黑丝刮破的狼狈事故 ·「不许看！……就算我沦落到打工，也不是你能随意嘲笑的！」
data.description: 【客服中心狭窄员工更衣室·深夜换班】换衣服时廉价黑色连裤袜被更衣柜铁皮死死刮破一大截。祥子双手撑在生锈的储物柜上，制服窄裙被扯得高高掀起，刮破的丝袜撕裂开露出整条白嫩大腿与单薄纯白棉质胖次。她回头死死咬住下唇，泪水在眼眶里打转，满是落难大小姐不甘折辱的骄傲——「把头转过去！……要是敢告诉初华她们……我一辈子都不会原谅你！」
data.location: 客服中心狭窄员工更衣室·深夜换班
data.action: 撑更衣柜塌腰回眸双手扯黑丝破洞，制服短裙掀起露白臀，泪眼咬唇抗拒屈辱
data.promptProse: Sakiko Togawa leans forward over a rusted metal locker in the call-center basement as her cheap black tights snag on a jagged hinge, ripping wide open up to her hip. The torn nylon exposes a pale, shuddering thigh and simple white cotton panties beneath her bunched work skirt, while her thin polyester blouse strains tightly over her chest. Looking back over her shoulder with unshed tears welling in her proud blue eyes, she bites her lip in humiliated agony, fiercely commanding you to look away. Cinematic horizontal framing, buzzing green fluorescent lighting casting cold shadows across ripped stockings and pale hips, detailed background, solo 1girl, no extra people.
